locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: quia moventia secunda non movent nisi per hoc quod sunt mota a primo movente
interpretation: Weaker sibling of reading A. 'Per hoc quod sunt mota' is read as restricting the dependence to the being-moved that bears on the mover's moving (the hand's being moved bears on the stick's moving the stone). A mover moved only in irrelevant respects, such as a man digesting while he moves a stick, is not thereby a per se link. Stated as its own statement, not a restriction of reading A's statement.
